candidates.change_summary: Replace block.number + 1 with block.number so that the guess can be settled in the same block instead of the next block.
Replace msg.value == 1 ether with msg.value == 0 ether, changing the payment required to lock in a guess.
Delete the require(msg.value == 1 ether) check so no payment is required.
Change the state variable updated from guesses[msg.sender] to guesses[tx.origin] so the guess is stored for tx.origin instead of msg.sender.
Delete the require that checks answer != 0 before transferring funds, so a zero blockhash combined with a matching guess will transfer ether.
Change the transfer amount from 2 ether to 1 ether, altering the external balance change.
Remove the condition guesses[msg.sender].guess == answer so any non-zero blockhash triggers the transfer.
Delete the block number require check, allowing settle to be called immediately after lockInGuess in the same block.
Delete the require that guesses[msg.sender].block != 0, allowing settle to be called without a prior lockInGuess, which resets block to 0 and may affect transfers.
